description: Coupled PK/PD model of circulating rituximab and CD19+ B-cell dynamics in multiple sclerosis. Rituximab declines through linear and B-cell-dependent loss, drives CD19+ cell depletion, and is linked to gradual B-cell repopulation through baseline production and turnover.
name: Rituximab exposure–CD19+ B-cell dynamics

L0_cells_mm3.description: Baseline CD19+ B-cell set point that determines cell production together with kout.
L0_cells_mm3.name: Baseline CD19+ lymphocytes

V_l.description: Apparent distribution volume; a dose of A mg raises the circulating concentration by A/V_l.
V_l.name: Volume

kel_day.description: First-order rate constant for nonspecific loss of circulating rituximab (the source parameter cl, in 1/day).
kel_day.name: Linear elimination rate constant

kdeg1_mm3_cell_day.description: Strength of the CD19-cell-dependent rituximab loss term in dC/dt. The dimensional unit is inferred from the source ODE because the model export does not declare physical units.
kdeg1_mm3_cell_day.name: Target-mediated concentration clearance

kdeg2_l_mg_day.description: Strength of rituximab-driven CD19+ B-cell depletion.
kdeg2_l_mg_day.name: RTX-driven B-cell depletion

kout_day.description: CD19+ B-cell turnover rate governing natural loss and return toward the baseline set point.
kout_day.name: B-cell turnover

omega_L0.description: Random-effect standard deviation for normally distributed L0.
omega_L0.name: IIV SD L0

residual_a1.description: Combined residual error additive term for RTX concentration.
residual_a1.name: RTX additive residual error

residual_a2.description: Combined residual error additive term for CD19+ lymphocytes.
residual_a2.name: CD19 additive residual error

residual_b1.description: Combined residual error proportional term for RTX concentration.
residual_b1.name: RTX proportional residual error

residual_b2.description: Combined residual error proportional term for CD19+ lymphocytes.
residual_b2.name: CD19 proportional residual error

subject1_L0_cells_mm3.description: Individual SAEM baseline CD19+ cells used for dynamic replay.
subject1_L0_cells_mm3.name: Subject 1 SAEM L0

subject1_V_l.description: Individual SAEM volume used for dynamic replay.
subject1_V_l.name: Subject 1 SAEM V

subject1_kel_day.description: Individual SAEM linear elimination rate constant (source cl) used for dynamic replay.
subject1_kel_day.name: Subject 1 SAEM kel

subject1_final_time_day.description: Last time with both RTX and CD19 Monolix prediction in exact dynamic replay window.
subject1_final_time_day.name: Subject 1 final overlay time

subject1_kdeg1.description: Individual SAEM kdeg1 used for dynamic replay; the dimensional unit is inferred from the published ODE because the Monolix export does not declare physical units.
subject1_kdeg1.name: Subject 1 SAEM kdeg1

subject1_kdeg2.description: Individual SAEM kdeg2 used for dynamic replay.
subject1_kdeg2.name: Subject 1 SAEM kdeg2

subject1_kout_day.description: Individual SAEM kout used for dynamic replay.
subject1_kout_day.name: Subject 1 SAEM kout

C.description: Circulating rituximab concentration available for linear clearance and CD19-cell-dependent drug loss. Doses enter as amount divided by V_l.
C.name: Rituximab concentration

L.description: Circulating CD19+ B-cell count governed by baseline production, natural turnover, and rituximab-driven depletion.
L.name: CD19+ lymphocyte count

elapsed_day.description: Time elapsed from the starting administration.
elapsed_day.name: Elapsed time
